claims.evidence: The witness report states the brand is null and was not read from the item.
Photo 0 shows the torch being held by a person, confirming its portable size.
Photo 1 shows a back panel with a plug icon, indicating a charging port.
The witness did not see the light beam or the bulb type.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be dead or have very low capacity.
risks.proof: A video showing the torch remaining lit for at least 10 minutes without being plugged in.
risks.if_unproven: as having a dead battery requiring replacement.

risks.risk: The LED or switch may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video clip of the torch being switched on and off.

risks.risk: The charging circuit may be faulty.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing a charging indicator light active when connected to power.

risks.risk: The required charging cable may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the torch alongside its charging cable.

proof_requests: Video of the torch being switched on and off.
Photo of the brand and model name printed on the casing.
Photo of the front lens to confirm LED type.
Photo of the charging cable if included.
response.reason: The item is identified as a rechargeable torch. It can be priced at the worst-case value for a generic non-functional unit until proof of operation and battery health is provided.
